name: next-campaign-schema-check
description: Runs the real migrations against a throwaway Postgres and asserts the spec catalogue, the price ladder, the anonymous read surface and the RLS boundaries.
comment: embedded-postgres downloads a throwaway Postgres 18 binary; the version is exact because only pre-release tags exist for the 18.x line.
optionalComment: OPTIONAL, and that is load-bearing. This package is win32-only, and the root install pulls in every workspace — so on a Linux build host npm hits EBADPLATFORM and the WHOLE install fails, taking the website down with a test dependency it never needed. As an optional dependency the platform mismatch is a warning that is skipped. The harness only ever runs on the developer's Windows machine, where the platform matches and it installs normally.
